g1_portable_reproduction_command:
JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu python - <<'PY'
from importlib import metadata
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import platform
import subprocess
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()))

import jax
import mujoco
import numpy as np

from foresight.adaptive.telemetry import ActuatorTelemetryLayout, sample_native_actuators
from foresight.envs.g1_impact.impact_joystick import ImpactJoystick, default_config

root = Path.cwd()
cfg = default_config()
cfg.impact.resample_on_autoreset = False
cfg.impact.reset_perturb = 0.
env = ImpactJoystick(config=cfg, config_overrides={'impl': 'jax'})
model = env.mj_model
layout = ActuatorTelemetryLayout.from_model(model)
assert model.nu == 29, model.nu
assert layout.qpos_adrs.shape == (29,) and layout.dof_adrs.shape == (29,)
assert len(np.unique(layout.qpos_adrs)) == 29
assert len(np.unique(layout.dof_adrs)) == 29
assert np.min(layout.qpos_adrs) >= 7
assert np.min(layout.dof_adrs) >= 6
assert not np.any(np.isin(layout.qpos_adrs,
                         np.arange(env._proj_qpos_adr, env._proj_qpos_adr+7)))
assert not np.any(np.isin(layout.dof_adrs,
                         np.arange(env._proj_qvel_adr, env._proj_qvel_adr+6)))
nominal_kp = model.actuator_gainprm[:, 0].copy()
nominal_bias = model.actuator_biasprm[:, 1].copy()
trials = []
for gain in (1., .7):
    model.actuator_gainprm[:, 0] = nominal_kp * gain
    model.actuator_biasprm[:, 1] = nominal_bias * gain
    data = mujoco.MjData(model)
    mujoco.mj_resetDataKeyframe(model, data, 0)
    data.time = .04
    velocities = np.linspace(-.2, .2, model.nu)
    data.qvel[:6] = .123
    data.qvel[layout.dof_adrs] = velocities
    data.qvel[env._proj_qvel_adr:env._proj_qvel_adr+6] = -.321
    offsets = np.where(np.arange(model.nu) % 2, -.01, .01)
    data.ctrl[:] = data.qpos[layout.qpos_adrs] + offsets
    # Deliberately stale force caches must not be forwarded to the packet.
    data.actuator_force[:] = -999.
    data.qfrc_actuator[:] = -777.
    before = {k: np.array(getattr(data, k), copy=True)
              for k in ('time', 'qpos', 'qvel', 'ctrl', 'actuator_force',
                        'qfrc_actuator', 'qacc_warmstart', 'sensordata')}
    packet = sample_native_actuators(model, data, layout)
    error = packet.held_target_rad - packet.joint_position_rad
    excited = np.abs(error) > 1e-9
    valid = np.asarray(packet.regression_valid)
    assert int(excited.sum()) == 29
    assert valid.all()
    expected = gain * nominal_kp * error
    np.testing.assert_allclose(packet.applied_joint_torque_nm, expected,
                               rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-12)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(packet.joint_position_rad, data.qpos[layout.qpos_adrs])
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(packet.joint_velocity_rad_s, velocities)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(packet.raw_actuator_force_nm, packet.applied_joint_torque_nm)
    assert float(packet.source_time_s) == .04
    for key, value in before.items():
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(getattr(data, key), value)
    inferred = packet.applied_joint_torque_nm / (nominal_kp * error)
    trials.append({'gain_used_only_by_simulator': gain,
                   'excited_joints': int(excited.sum()),
                   'regression_valid_joints': int(valid.sum()),
                   'max_force_identity_error_nm': float(np.max(np.abs(packet.applied_joint_torque_nm-expected))),
                   'max_gain_recovery_error': float(np.max(np.abs(inferred-gain))),
                   'source_time_s': float(packet.source_time_s),
                   'input_state_preserved': True})
model.actuator_gainprm[:, 0] = nominal_kp
model.actuator_biasprm[:, 1] = nominal_bias
result = {'status': 'pass', 'environment_class': 'ImpactJoystick',
          'environment_impl': 'jax', 'sampling_backend': 'native MuJoCo',
          'policy_rollout': False, 'full_G1_jit': False,
          'nu': model.nu, 'nq': model.nq, 'nv': model.nv,
          'qpos_addresses': layout.qpos_adrs.tolist(),
          'dof_addresses': layout.dof_adrs.tolist(),
          'projectile_qpos_address': int(env._proj_qpos_adr),
          'projectile_dof_address': int(env._proj_qvel_adr),
          'gain_trials': trials}
print(json.dumps(result, indent=2, allow_nan=False))
PY
